# ADR-3066: A06: Unmaintained library retention for legacy app 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Abandoned libraries accumulate exploit PoCs.

## Decision

Teams MUST NOT keep an unmaintained library retention for legacy app 6 (A06-6) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Exceptions include compensating controls.
